description: ICICI Pru Wish is a health insurance plan designed specifically for women, providing coverage for critical illnesses, surgeries, and maternity-related complications. The plan offers two options: Health Care and Health Care Plus, with the latter including additional coverage for maternity care. The plan provides a lump sum payout upon diagnosis of a covered critical illness or surgery, and also offers a premium sabbatical benefit, allowing policyholders to take a break from paying premiums for a year. The plan is available for women aged 21-55 years, with a coverage term of 8-30 years, and a minimum sum assured of Rs. 10 lakhs.

features.feature_value: Critical Illnesses, Surgeries, and Maternity Complications
features.feature_description: The plan provides coverage for a range of critical illnesses, surgeries, and maternity-related complications, including minor and major conditions, and newborn complications.
Policyholders can take a break from paying premiums for a year, while still enjoying full policy benefits.

features.feature_value: Premium remains guaranteed throughout the coverage term
features.feature_description: The premium amount remains the same throughout the coverage term, providing policyholders with financial stability and predictability.

features.feature_value: Coverage for pregnancy complications and newborn complications
features.feature_description: The plan provides coverage for maternity-related complications, including pregnancy complications and newborn complications, under the Health Care Plus option.

features.feature_value: Fixed lump sum payout on diagnosis of a covered critical illness
features.feature_description: Policyholders receive a lump sum payout upon diagnosis of a covered critical illness, providing financial support during a difficult time.

features.feature_value: Coverage for surgeries resulting from specific illnesses
features.feature_description: The plan provides coverage for surgeries resulting from specific illnesses, including breast reconstructive surgery, skin grafting, and hysterectomy.

A Plan to Fit Your Needs
You are the pillar of your family, holding everything together with love, care, and 
unshakable strength. Balancing numerous responsibilities- family commitments, 
work deadlines, and maintaining a social life, can often leave little time to focus 
on your own well-being. While the health of your family, spouse, and children 
may take priority, it is equally important to prioritize your own health. After all, 
your well-being is the foundation that supports everything you do. 
At ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Co. Ltd., we understand that as a woman, you 
often prioritize the needs of your loved ones above your own, sometimes at the 
expense of your own well-being. That’s why we are here to support and 
safeguard your needs, ensuring you are always protected With ICICI Pru Wish we

Care Plus Plan Option. The Policyholders can choose from the following two 
options depending on their need:
i. Health Care Plan Option provides cover against the Minor and Major Critical 
Illnesses under Vital Care Beneﬁt and against Surgeries under Surgical Care 
Beneﬁt. The list of Critical Illnesses and Surgeries are mentioned later in this 
section.
ii. Health Care Plus Plan Option provides the Vital Care and Surgical Care

section.
ii. Health Care Plus Plan Option provides the Vital Care and Surgical Care 
Beneﬁt and an additional Maternity Care Beneﬁt which covers the maternity 
and childbirth related complications. The detailed list of Critical illnesses 
covered under Maternity Care Beneﬁt is mentioned later in this section.

It offers comprehensive protection, life cover, accidental death cover, and accidental disability cover, along with potential to earn higher returns through market-linked investments.

At policy inception you specify the funds and the proportion in which the premiums are to be 
saved in the funds. At the time of payment of subsequent premiums, depending on your market 
outlook, you may change the split in which the premiums are to be saved in the funds, without 
any charge. This will not count as a switch. This feature is applicable only if you have opted for

b) Target Asset Allocation Strategy
This strategy enables you to choose an asset allocation that is best suited to your risk appetite 
and maintains it throughout the policy term.
You can allocate your premiums between any two funds available with this policy, in the 
proportion of your choice. Your portfolio will be rebalanced every quarter to ensure that this 
asset allocation is maintained.

Under this strategy, your savings will initially be distributed between two funds Multi Cap Growth 
Fund, an equity oriented fund, and Income Fund, a debt oriented fund in a 75%: 25% proportion. 
The fund allocation may subsequently get altered due to market movements. We will re-balance 
funds in the portfolio based on a trigger event.
Working of the strategy:
• The trigger event is deﬁned as a 10% upward or downward movement in NAV of Multi Cap 
Growth Fund, since the previous rebalancing. For determining the ﬁrst trigger event, the 
movement of 10% in NAV of Multi Cap Growth Fund (details on fund options available under 
the product are available in the “Choice of Funds” above) will be measured vis-à-vis the NAV

movement of 10% in NAV of Multi Cap Growth Fund (details on fund options available under 
the product are available in the “Choice of Funds” above) will be measured vis-à-vis the NAV 
at the inception of your strategy.
• On the occurrence of the trigger event, any fund value in Multi Cap Growth Fund which is in 
excess of three times the Income Fund, fund value is considered as gains and is transferred to 
the liquid fund - Money Market Fund by cancellation of appropriate units from the Multi Cap 
Growth Fund. This ensures that gains are capitalized, while maintaining the asset allocation 
between Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund at 75%:25%
• In case there are no gains to be capitalized, funds in Multi Cap Growth Fund, Income Fund and 
Money Market Fund are redistributed in Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund in 75:25 
proportion.

b.   Target Asset Allocation Strategy
This strategy enables you to choose an asset allocation that is best suited to your risk appetite and 
maintains it throughout the policy term.
You can allocate your premiums between any two funds available with this policy, in the proportion 
of your choice. Your portfolio will be rebalanced every quarter to ensure that this asset allocation is 
maintained.

quarter is a non-working day, then the next working day’s NAV (i.e. the price per unit of the Fund) 
will be applicable.
c.   Trigger Portfolio Strategy 2
Under this strategy, your savings will initially be distributed between two funds Multi Cap Growth 
Fund, an equity oriented fund, and Income Fund, a debt oriented fund in a 75%: 25% proportion. 
The fund allocation may subsequently get altered due to market movements. We will re-balance 
funds in the portfolio based on a trigger event.

The fund allocation may subsequently get altered due to market movements. We will re-balance 
funds in the portfolio based on a trigger event.
Working of the strategy:
• The trigger event is deﬁned as a 10% upward or downward movement in NAV of Multi Cap 
Growth Fund, since the previous rebalancing. For determining the ﬁrst trigger event, the 
movement of 10% in NAV of Multi Cap Growth Fund (details on fund options available under 
the product are available in the “Choice of Funds” above) will be measured vis-à-vis the NAV 
at the inception of your strategy.
• On the occurrence of the trigger event, any fund value in Multi Cap Growth Fund which is in 
excess of three times the Income Fund, fund value is considered as gains and is transferred to 
the liquid fund - Money Market Fund by cancellation of appropriate units from the Multi Cap 
Growth Fund. This ensures that gains are capitalized, while maintaining the asset allocation 
between Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund at 75%:25%

Growth Fund. This ensures that gains are capitalized, while maintaining the asset allocation 
between Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund at 75%:25%
• In case there are no gains to be capitalized, funds in Multi Cap Growth Fund, Income Fund and 
Money Market Fund are redistributed in Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund in 75:25 
proportion.

c.   Trigger Portfolio Strategy 2
Under this strategy, your savings will initially be distributed between two funds Multi Cap Growth 
Fund, an equity oriented fund, and Income Fund, a debt oriented fund in a 75%: 25% proportion. 
The fund allocation may subsequently get altered due to market movements. We will re-balance 
funds in the portfolio based on a trigger event.
Working of the strategy:
• The trigger event is deﬁned as a 10% upward or downward movement in NAV of Multi Cap 
Growth Fund, since the previous rebalancing. For determining the ﬁrst trigger event, the 
movement of 10% in NAV of Multi Cap Growth Fund (details on fund options available under 
the product are available in the “Choice of Funds” above) will be measured vis-à-vis the NAV 
at the inception of your strategy.

• On the occurrence of the trigger event, any fund value in Multi Cap Growth Fund which is in 
excess of three times the Income Fund, fund value is considered as gains and is transferred to 
the liquid fund - Money Market Fund by cancellation of appropriate units from the Multi Cap 
Growth Fund. This ensures that gains are capitalized, while maintaining the asset allocation 
between Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund at 75%:25%
• In case there are no gains to be capitalized, funds in Multi Cap Growth Fund, Income Fund and 
Money Market Fund are redistributed in Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund in 75:25 
proportion.

This strategy enables you to choose an asset allocation that is best suited to your risk appetite and 
maintains it throughout the policy term.
You can allocate your premiums between any two funds available with this policy, in the proportion 
of your choice. Your portfolio will be rebalanced every quarter to ensure that this asset allocation is 
maintained.

quarter is a non-working day, then the next working day’s NAV (i.e. the price per unit of the Fund) 
will be applicable.

c.   Trigger Portfolio Strategy 2
Under this strategy, your savings will initially be distributed between two funds Multi Cap Growth 
Fund, an equity oriented fund, and Income Fund, a debt oriented fund in a 75%: 25% proportion. 
The fund allocation may subsequently get altered due to market movements. We will re-balance 
funds in the portfolio based on a trigger event.
Working of the strategy:
• The trigger event is deﬁned as a 10% upward or downward movement in NAV of Multi Cap 
Growth Fund, since the previous rebalancing. For determining the ﬁrst trigger event, the 
movement of 10% in NAV of Multi Cap Growth Fund (details on fund options available under

excess of three times the Income Fund, fund value is considered as gains and is transferred to 
the liquid fund - Money Market Fund by cancellation of appropriate units from the Multi Cap 
Growth Fund. This ensures that gains are capitalized, while maintaining the asset allocation 
between Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund at 75%:25%
• In case there are no gains to be capitalized, funds in Multi Cap Growth Fund, Income Fund and 
Money Market Fund are redistributed in Multi Cap Growth Fund and Income Fund in 75:25

Secure your family under Married Woman’s Property Act (MWPA)
Through this feature, you have an option to secure the corpus for the beneﬁt of your wife/ or Children/ or 
Wife and Children as the funds under the policy cannot be attached by creditors and claimants*.
Under section 6 of the Married Woman’s Property Act, 1874, a married man can take an insurance policy 
on his own life, and express it to be for the beneﬁt of his wife and children. When such intent is expressed 
on the face of the policy, it shall be deemed to be a trust for the beneﬁt of the named beneﬁciaries and it 
shall not be subject to the control of the husband, or his creditors, or form part of his estate. 
*Unless taken otherwise with the intent to defraud creditors. In case of any third party claim in the courts

of India with regards the insurance proceeds, the amount shall be subject to the judiciary directions.

description: ICICI Pru GIFT Pro is a protection and savings-oriented life insurance plan designed to provide financial protection to your family while helping you achieve life goals like marriage, parenthood, children's education, and retirement through guaranteed benefits. It offers extensive flexibility in choosing life cover, income options, MoneyBack benefits, and payout timings.

features.feature_description: Provides financial security to the family in case of the Life Assured's demise during the policy term.
Policyholders can choose to receive Guaranteed Income that either remains level throughout the Income Period or increases every year at a simple interest rate of 5% p.a.
Flexibility to select the duration of Guaranteed Income as per individual needs (5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30 years).
Option to choose a lump sum MoneyBack Benefit as any percentage from 0% to 200% of the sum total of all annualized premiums payable. This choice impacts the regular income amount.
Flexibility to choose any year, on or after the maturity date of the policy up to the last income year, to receive the MoneyBack Benefit.
An option at inception to receive additional Guaranteed Income for opting a lower life cover.
Allows policyholders to choose any specific date (e.g., spouse’s birthdate, anniversary) for annual Guaranteed Income payouts.

features.feature_name: Lump Sum Conversion of Future Benefits
features.feature_description: Option to receive all future Guaranteed Incomes and MoneyBack Benefit (if applicable) as a discounted lump sum at policy maturity or any time during the income period. The discount rate is based on 30-year Government Securities yield + 1.00%.
Policyholders paying higher annualized premiums receive an additional guaranteed income rate (ranging from 0% to 3.75% of Annualized Premium), which increases with higher premium thresholds.

In case of the Life Assured's death during the policy term, a lump sum Death Benefit is paid. It is the highest of four defined values, including Sum Assured on Death (based on age and Low Cover Income Booster choice), 105% of Total Premiums Paid, and Surrender Value. If death occurs during the Income Period, the claimant continues to receive Guaranteed Income and MoneyBack Benefit, or can opt for a discounted lump sum.

If premiums stop after the first policy year, the policy continues with reduced Paid-up Maturity Benefit (Paid-up GI and Paid-up MoneyBack Benefit) and Paid-up Death Benefit. No benefits are payable if premiums stop in the first policy year.
Tax benefits may be applicable on premiums paid and benefits received as per the prevailing tax laws.
The product is also available for purchase online.
No specific product exclusions (e.g., suicide clause, specific hazardous activities) are explicitly mentioned in the provided brochure text. General disclaimers about fraudulent calls are present.

description: ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus is a new-age term life insurance plan designed to provide financial security to your loved ones. It offers flexibility to customize coverage, add accidental death cover, and adapt to changing life goals, ensuring peace of mind for the modern individual.

features.feature_description: Option to skip premium payment for one year to support during financial downturns.
Flexibility to pay premiums once (Single Pay), for a limited period (Limited Pay), or throughout the policy term (Regular Pay).
Option to change the premium payment term from Regular Pay to Limited Pay.

Option to increase life cover at key life stages (marriage, birth/adoption of 1st child, birth/adoption of 2nd child, disbursement of home loan) for Regular Pay policies. Additional premium calculated based on increased Sum Assured and outstanding policy term.
Maximum additional Sum Assured allowed upon marriage.
Maximum additional Sum Assured allowed upon birth or legal adoption of 1st child.
Maximum additional Sum Assured allowed upon birth or legal adoption of 2nd child.
Maximum additional Sum Assured allowed upon disbursement of a home loan.
Instant relief up to ₹3,00,000 on claim intimation as an accelerated Death Benefit.

features.feature_value: Death Benefit Payout Options (Life & Life Plus Variants)
features.feature_description: Choose to receive the Death Benefit as a Lump Sum, Income Option, Lump Sum and Income Option, or Increasing Income Option. Selection must be made at policy inception and cannot be changed.

features.feature_name: Death Benefit Payout - Lump Sum Option
features.feature_description: Entire Death Benefit amount is payable as a lump sum.
10% of the Death Benefit amount is payable every year for 10 years in equal monthly instalments (0.83333% per month). Claimant can advance the first year's income as lump sum.

features.feature_name: Death Benefit Payout - Lump Sum and Income Option
features.feature_description: A chosen percentage of the Death Benefit is paid as a lump sum, and the remaining amount is paid in equal monthly instalments (0.83333% per month) over 10 years.

features.feature_name: Death Benefit Payout - Increasing Income Option
features.feature_description: Death Benefit payable in monthly instalments for 10 years, starting with 10% p.a. in the first year, increasing at 10% p.a. simple interest thereafter. Total payout over 10 years equals 145% of Sum Assured on Death.

features.feature_value: Convert Outstanding Income to Lump Sum
features.feature_description: At claim intimation or anytime after the start of monthly income, the Claimant can convert outstanding monthly income into a lump sum payout. Discount rates apply (6.50% p.a. at intimation; higher of 6.50% and 10-year G-Sec yield after first payment).

Provides coverage against death only. Death Benefit payable is higher of 7 times Annualized Premium, 105% of Total Premiums Paid, or Sum Assured on Death (for Regular/Limited Pay); or higher of 125% of Single Premium or Sum Assured on Death (for Single Pay).

Provides coverage against death and Accidental Death Benefit (ADB). Sum Assured on Death and ADB Sum Assured are set at purchase and remain constant throughout the policy term. ADB is an additional lump sum for accidental death.

Provides coverage against death and Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) with varying Sum Assured. Sum Assured on Death increases from 25% (Year 1) to 100% (Year 11 onwards) of chosen Sum Assured. ADB Sum Assured decreases from 75% (Year 1) to 0% (Year 11 onwards) of chosen Sum Assured. ADB is payable only for the first 10 policy years.

If the Life Assured is diagnosed with a Terminal Illness (highly likely to lead to death within 6 months), the Death Benefit is accelerated and paid. This is not an additional benefit; the policy terminates upon payment. Not available for policies sourced through POS personnel.
Special premium rates for non-tobacco users.
Special discount on the first year’s premium for salaried customers.
15% discount on premium rates for life cover (Death Benefit) as compared to male lives.
Tax benefits may be applicable on premiums paid and benefits received as per the prevailing tax laws.
There is no maturity, paid-up value, or survival benefit available under this product.

For Single Pay policies, Surrender Value is 25% x [1 – (Policy Month of surrender – 1)/ (Policy Term x 12)] x Total Premiums Paid. For Limited Pay, if one full year's premium is paid, a formula based on premiums paid and policy term applies; otherwise, it's 0. For Regular Pay, it's 0 unless PPT was changed to Limited Pay and one full year's premium paid post-change, then a formula applies. Policy terminates on payment.

Option to cancel the policy and receive Total Premiums Paid (excluding extra premium, rider premium, taxes). Can be exercised after the 25th policy year but not during the last 5 policy years, if age is 60 years or more, and policy is in-force. If PPT changed, 3 policy years must have elapsed from change date. Cannot be availed simultaneously with Surrender Benefit.
Death Benefit shall not be payable if death occurs on the Date of Maturity; policy terminates.

features.feature_value: Accidental Death on Date of Maturity (Life Plus)
features.feature_description: Accidental Death Benefit Sum Assured is not payable if the accident occurs on the Date of Maturity, subsequently resulting in death.

eligibility.accidental_death_benefit_max_sum_assured: 3 times of Sum Assured chosen, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy
eligibility.accidental_death_benefit_pos_sum_assured: Equal to Sum Assured on Death, max as per Board Approved Underwriting Policy
eligibility.life_variant_regular_pay_policy_term_ran: 5 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.life_variant_limited_pay_policy_term_ran: 10 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
Whole Life (99 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.life_plus_variant_regular_pay_policy_ter: 5 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.life_plus_variant_limited_pay_policy_ter: 10 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
Whole Life (99 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.life_rebalancing_variant_regular_pay_pol: 15 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.life_rebalancing_variant_limited_pay_ppt: 5, 7, 10, 15 years & up to 60 years of age
eligibility.life_rebalancing_variant_limited_pay_pol: 15 years to (85 - Age at Entry) years
eligibility.pos_policies_life_lifeplus_policy_term_d: Available policy term in multiples of 1 year between minimum and maximum policy term up to age of 65 years.

description: ICICI Pru SmartKid 360 is a life insurance plan designed to help parents plan for their child's future milestones, such as education and hobbies, with guaranteed financial support. The plan provides a range of benefits, including MoneyBack payouts, a Special Achievement Award, and a Family Income Benefit, to ensure that the child's dreams are always backed with certainty, even in the unfortunate event of the parent's passing.

features.feature_description: The policyholder can receive one or more MoneyBack benefits, which can be set as a percentage of the Assured Benefit, not exceeding 50% in any policy year.

The policyholder can exercise this feature if the child achieves certain milestones, such as admission to a top university or winning a medal in a sports event, and receive a lump sum payment of 20% of the Guaranteed Maturity Benefit.
The policyholder can opt for a Family Income Benefit, which will provide a regular income to the claimant in the event of the policyholder's death, until the date of maturity.

features.feature_value: Accumulate MoneyBack benefits with loyalty addition
features.feature_description: The policyholder can accumulate MoneyBack benefits with a loyalty addition, which will accrue daily at the prevailing reverse repo rate published by the Reserve Bank of India.
The policyholder can take a loan against the policy, up to 80% of the Surrender Value, at an interest rate that will be reviewed monthly.

You can Surrender the policy any time after payment of at least one full policy year’s premium. Prior to receipt 
of one full policy year’s premium, no surrender value is payable.
On policy surrender, we will pay the Surrender Value equal to the higher of the following:
  • Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV)
  • Special Surrender Value (SSV)
The policy will terminate on payment of the Surrender Value and all rights, beneﬁts and interests under the 
policy shall stand extinguished.
GSV will be calculated as follows:
GSV = GSV factor x Total Premiums Paid less {all MoneyBack beneﬁts paid (if any) till date of surrender plus 
the beneﬁt paid under the Special Achievement Award feature (if exercised)}, subject to a minimum of zero.
